name: Research portal (projects list + tabs)
purpose: Front door of Starr Recon. A searchable, filterable list of research projects, with six other former pages folded in as tabs (Coverage, Library, Sites, Self-heal, Pipeline, Billing).

elements.name: Search + Filter
elements.does: Filters stacked project cards (name, status chip, address, created date, linked job).

elements.name: + New Research Project
elements.does: Opens NewResearchProjectModal; ?new=1 and ?new=1&job=<id> deep links open it pre-filled.

elements.name: Tab strip
elements.does: Projects, Coverage, Library, Sites, Self-heal, Pipeline, Billing; old routes (/coverage, /library, /sites, /self-heal, /pipeline, /billing) still exist as forwarders.

elements.name: Worker status banner
elements.does: Shows whether the research worker is reachable (WorkerStatusBanner, /api/admin/research/worker-status).

behaviours: Pipeline and billing tabs were bundle-exempt operator tools; as tabs they now sit under the 'recon' bundle gate (operators bypass it).
problems: Seven tabs mix daily-use (projects) with engine administration (self-heal, sites, pipeline); a field user sees dead-end operator tabs.
/admin/research/testing is a separate lab with its own middleware entry and is not reachable from the tabs.
rebuild: One screen: 'Research' = list of runs for a job/address with status chip, address, date, linked job. Everything operator-only (sites, self-heal, pipeline, billing, testing) moves under one Settings > Research Engine area so a party chief or office manager sees only runs and results.
nationwide: Single-tenant admin; bundle gate 'recon' per org exists. Firm name and county list (org_counties, seed 519) must drive list defaults.

name: New research project modal and Research-from-job
purpose: Creates a project with address (structured fields), county, owner, instrument, survey type, budget settings and attached files; from a job it inherits address, client, documents and map library.

elements.name: Confirm screen
elements.does: Shows inherited fields and what is missing; nothing is written until the button is pressed (avoids Next.js prefetch creating rows).

elements.name: Gather selections / spend limit / supplemental info
elements.does: GatherSelectionsField, SpendLimitSlider, SupplementalInfoFields feed run settings.

elements.name: Job file offer
elements.does: offerJobFiles proposes job documents to attach as already-held.

behaviours: A job has client_name only, no parcel id or owner; the page asks a human to confirm (client may be a title company).
problems: Confirm screen adds a click on the most common path.
Address entry is free text plus parts; no map pick.
rebuild: One 'Start research' sheet: address (autocomplete to parcel), county auto-detected, what-do-you-need checklist, budget slider; inherit everything from the job without a confirm screen when nothing is ambiguous.
nationwide: State is not asked; county list is Texas. Needs a state field and per-state county lists.

name: Project hub (five-stage workflow)
purpose: The working screen for one property. Stages: upload, research, analysis, review, jobprep. Runs gather, shows live progress, documents, data points, discrepancies, drawing, purchases and exports.

elements.name: PipelineStepper
elements.does: User-facing stages mapped from internal WorkflowStep values.

elements.name: Panels
elements.does: Briefing, AnalysisEstimate, ReviewDocumentsList, PurchaseOffers, DataPoints, Discrepancy, Adjoiners, Encumbrance, SurveyPlan, PacketBuilder, ReportCard, RunDiff, VendorAccounts, Export, ArtifactGallery, SourceDocumentViewer, DrawingCanvas.

elements.name: Rerun dialog
elements.does: RerunDialog edits run settings before starting; no longer auto-starts with defaults.

elements.name: RunAiReviewControl
elements.does: Starts AI document reading after gather.

behaviours: Gather run does no AI work; AI review is a separate action with its own estimate and bar.
DELETE .../analyze unsticks a stuck project back to 'configure'.
Document source tags: property_search, user_upload, linked_reference, manual_entry.
problems: One 3,545-line client component with about 40 panels; hard to test and reason about.
Two stage vocabularies (WorkflowStep vs PipelineStage) must stay in sync.
Many panels overlap (data points, boundary calls, survey plan, report card).
rebuild: Split the 3,545-line page into a run timeline (what we searched, found, could not reach, spent), a documents/evidence board, and a result dossier (parcel, chain of title, boundary calls, encumbrances, confidence). Gather and AI review stay separate actions as the gather/review split already does.
add: Chain-of-title timeline as the primary result
One-click send to CAD/job carrying parcel, calls and documents
Per-fact evidence side panel (source image crop)
nationwide: Texas deed vocabulary (vara, abstract, survey) in labels and prompts; county detection assumes Texas.

name: Project document library
purpose: All documents filed to a project: fetched deeds/plats, bought documents, uploads, linked references, with filters and a viewer.
behaviours: The header records a bug where 17 rows rendered blank because the page cast the API to a shape no code produced (found 2026-08-31).
problems: Duplicate of the library tab and of the hub review list.
rebuild: Fold into the project hub evidence board; keep one viewer with annotations and OCR text.
nationwide: Document types are Texas-flavoured (plat, deed, metes_and_bounds).

name: Interactive boundary viewer
purpose: SVG view of the reconciled boundary with confidence colouring, click-to-inspect per call, layer toggles and a measure tool.
problems: Depends on a successful reconcile; empty when Phase 7 has not produced a model (most non-Bell runs).
rebuild: Make it the core result view: parcel on aerial/GIS base, calls table beside it, colour by confidence, evidence popover per call.
nationwide: Closure thresholds Texas-based; no PLSS section-corner view.

name: Mobile field report
purpose: Phone-friendly card view for a party chief on site: confidence, boundary calls, monuments, discrepancies.
problems: Only as good as extracted data; no monument photos or access notes.
rebuild: Keep, but make it offline-capable (packet PDF and offline already exist) and promote it out of admin nav; it is the one view a field crew will open.
nationwide: None specific.

name: Drawing canvas, tools and templates
purpose: A 2,678-line in-browser canvas for drawing the boundary from extracted data, editing vertices, annotating and saving versions.
problems: Duplicates the CAD editor under app/admin/cad.
Largest component after the hub; hard to maintain.
rebuild: Do not keep a second drafting tool inside Research. Send the boundary to the CAD area (export-to-cad route already exists) and keep a read-only preview here.
nationwide: Bearing/distance conventions assume Texas surveys (feet, varas converted).

name: Coverage tab and County profiles panel
purpose: Shows which of 254 counties the platform can research, by tier (curated, vendor-default, fallback) and per source.
behaviours: Tier comes from resolveCountyProfile; worker GET /research/county-profiles (+/:county) with an app proxy; same function the router uses.
Last-green dates are empty: no drill has run (research_adapter_canaries held zero rows when last measured).
problems: 'Vendor-default' conflates configured with working: BIS rows for Williamson and Milam pointed at hosts that do not resolve.
App-side SUPPORTED_COUNTIES is ['bell'] only (verify-lot returns 400 elsewhere).
Nine overlapping county registries remain, only asserted equal.
rebuild: Make it the owner's single Texas coverage truth: one row per county and source with state (works / partial / missing / paid-only) and last-green date, driven by drills, not registry intent.
nationwide: 254-county Texas table; per-firm coverage lives in org_counties (seed 519) and is separate from capability.
plans: docs/planning/pending/COUNTY_CURATION_SYSTEM_2026-09-09.md (open: golden parcels, drill command, scheduled drills, registry consolidation, owner-ordered county list)

name: Sites tab (adapter registry and probe)
purpose: Register a county data site (vendor, URL, field map), probe it and see health; backed by research_site_adapters and data_vendors.
problems: Seeds 540/541/555/557 leave most adapters draft with survey_status not_surveyed; the DB registry and the worker code registries disagree.
The worker routes from compiled sets, not from these DB rows.
rebuild: Keep the registry idea (vendor template plus county config) but make the code profile and the DB row one thing, and let a new county be added by pasting a URL that the probe classifies.
nationwide: research_counties has a state column (default TX), so the schema is multi-state ready; data is Texas only.

name: Self-heal tab, sweep and portal watch
purpose: Toggle for automated adapter repair (default OFF), a manual sweep of every registered adapter, repair proposals, and a search for county portal-migration announcements.
problems: Probes selectors, not answers; the structural monitor reported Bell down for a week because of a bad probe URL and selector (curation plan).
Canary rows never created.
rebuild: Keep the sweep and announcement watch (cheap, useful); make proposals draft a profile change for human review rather than auto-apply.
nationwide: Vendor-generic; fine.

name: Pipeline tab (batch, flood zone, chain of title)
purpose: Dashboard for batch research jobs, ad hoc flood-zone queries and chain-of-title lookups.
problems: The name collides with the 'pipeline' API route and the worker pipeline; unclear to users.
rebuild: Batch becomes 'run for many parcels' on the projects list; flood zone and chain of title are results inside a project, not tools.
nationwide: FEMA is national; chain of title uses Texas instrument conventions.

name: Billing tab, vendor accounts and purchase log
purpose: Subscription, usage, invoices and the document-purchase transaction log; per-vendor paid accounts (TexasFile, Kofile, etc.).
problems: research_document_purchases had 0 rows when last measured: no run has ever bought a document.
Stripe (14 root vs 17 worker) and Zod (4 vs 3) major versions differ (RECON_INVENTORY).
Most vendor credentials were empty.
rebuild: Single spend ledger per project and per firm (AI, purchases, browser sessions) with a hard ceiling; product billing (Stripe) kept apart from internal cost tracking.
nationwide: Single Starr TexasFile account; per-firm vendor accounts needed.
plans: docs/planning/pending/OWNER_ACTIONS_RESEARCH_AND_MARKETING.md (open: authorise one paid run; iDocket, Mapbox, Browserbase billing decisions)

name: Global document library
purpose: Search every research document across all projects by text, type and county.
problems: File header records an earlier cast that matched nothing; re-verify rendering.
rebuild: Make it the per-firm county records cache (a firm's accumulated plats and deeds become an asset) with dedupe by instrument identity.
add: Dedup across projects by instrument number
nationwide: Per-firm isolation needed; private docs seed 669.

name: Testing lab (developer tool)
purpose: Developer lab: run pipeline stages, AI analyse/chat, git branch pull/push from the browser.
problems: Web routes for git push, pull and branches and file access under /api/admin/research/testing.
rebuild: Delete from the product; keep as a developer-only script or CLI. Git push/pull from an admin web route is a risk.
nationwide: n/a

name: Project API group (/api/admin/research/[projectId]/*)
purpose: About 55 route handlers for one project: documents, analyze, pipeline, lite-pipeline, data points, discrepancies, drawings, boundary, offers/purchase, packets, runs, search, share, tax, topo, verify-lot, versions, survey-plan and more.
behaviours: pipeline/ proxies to the worker; lite-pipeline/ runs the in-process Next.js pipeline; verify-lot reads Bell CAD ArcGIS directly and returns 400 for other counties (county-support.ts).
problems: Two pipelines reachable (worker vs lite).
Per-county guards hard-coded to Bell (the audit counts 106 single-county references).
deep-lot-analysis, deep-analyze and full-extract overlap.
rebuild: One run-oriented API: POST /runs, GET /runs/:id/events (SSE), GET /projects/:id/dossier, POST /documents. The rest are views over the dossier.
nationwide: Bell-only guards; county key assumes Texas names.

name: Admin API group (coverage, sites, self-heal, county-profiles, egress, worker-status, requests, templates, testing)
purpose: The engine-administration endpoints behind the admin tabs, plus egress allow-list, paid document access and request intake.
problems: Historic gap: five of six tab endpoints answered any signed-in account until C11b-0.
rebuild: Keep behind one operator namespace; check the role in every handler (C11b-0 was needed because five endpoints answered any signed-in user).
nationwide: Egress allow-list is global, not per firm.

name: In-app 'lite' pipeline (lib/research)
purpose: The Vercel-side research implementation: about 30 services including Bell CAD ArcGIS, web scraping, AI analysis and cross-validation. A recorded decision says the worker is canonical and lite becomes a thin client.
problems: Duplicates worker Bell logic and the AI client (two AI clients, two pipelines).
Prompts hard-code 'Texas RPLS' (prompts.ts:34, 92, 188, 264, 294).
rebuild: Delete after the worker owns all gathering and reading; keep a typed client for the worker run API and the UI-side services (drawing, export). One AI client, not two.
nationwide: Texas wording and Bell-only fetchers.
plans: docs/platform/RECON_INVENTORY.md (Phase A: lite becomes thin client; not done)

name: Worker HTTP API (Express)
purpose: One 8,776-line Express file exposing the engine: validate-address, property-lookup, full-pipeline, per-phase endpoints (discover, harvest, analyze, subdivision, adjacent, row, reconcile, confidence, purchase), topo, tax, lidar, cross-county, pause/resume/step/cancel, county-profiles, site health and a deploy trigger.
behaviours: requireAuth plus per-route rateLimit; /admin/deploy lets the app trigger a worker update.
problems: 8,776 lines in index.ts; phase endpoints duplicate full-pipeline orchestration.
rebuild: Split into route modules; one 'run' resource with events; each phase a function, not a public endpoint. Keep pause/resume/step for debugging.
nationwide: No state parameter on most routes.

name: County router and county profiles
purpose: Single entry point: normalises the county, validates the address belongs to it, resolves a profile for all 254 counties (curated, vendor-default, fallback) and dispatches to a dedicated module or the generic pipeline.
behaviours: Curated today: Bell, Milam, Williamson (CURATED list).
detectCountyFromAddress and per-county city lists (isBellCountyAddress, MILAM_COUNTY_CITIES) verify the county.
problems: The Williamson profile says the appraisal vendor is TrueAutomation at search.wcad.org while county-fips.ts still tags Williamson bis_consultants.
TEXAS_COUNTIES is a hard-coded 254 table with cadSystem baked in.
rebuild: This is the right spine. Extend profiles to carry state, legal system and source adapters, and make every other registry a derived view of profiles.
nationwide: TEXAS_COUNTIES and state default 'TX'; needs a StateConfig and per-state county tables.

name: Generic research pipeline (stages 0-5)
purpose: The path every non-curated county takes: normalise address, CAD lookup, visual evidence capture, clerk document retrieval (iterative), OCR and AI extraction, geometric reconciliation, validation, synthesis.

elements.name: Stage 0
elements.does: Address normalisation and county capability discovery.

elements.name: Stage 1
elements.does: Property identification via CAD; falls through to clerk when CAD is unreachable.

elements.name: Stage 1.5
elements.does: Visual evidence (aerials, GIS captures) before the document grind.

elements.name: Stage 2
elements.does: Document retrieval from clerk and plat sources, iterative discovery loop.

elements.name: Stage 3 / 3.5
elements.does: OCR plus AI deep analysis; geometric reconciliation.

elements.name: Stage 4 / 5
elements.does: Boundary validation; property validation pipeline and synthesis.

behaviours: The progress bar is a duration-weighted clock over 13 rungs (about 1,350 s); only anchored phase names advance it.
Budgets: gather cost estimate, run ceiling, purchase gate treats unreadable permission as deny.
problems: A 3,160-line file; the Williamson run spent 12 minutes concluding nothing because the configured CAD host never existed (docs/research/williamson-county-discovery).
Stage 1 failures surfaced as 'no records', a statement about the property rather than about routing.
Bell-specific cascade code lives inside the generic pipeline (pipeline.ts:772-905).
rebuild: Keep the stage order the owner set (plats/drawings, then overhead views, then other documents); put each stage behind a SourceAdapter interface and make stage results typed outputs with 'unreachable' distinct from 'none found'.
nationwide: Every stage assumes the Texas CAD plus clerk model, GLO abstracts and Texas legal phrases.

name: Nine-phase master orchestrator (phases 1-9)
purpose: Calls each phase endpoint in order (discover, harvest, analyze, subdivision, adjacent, row, reconcile, confidence, purchase) with checkpoint/resume and non-critical phase tolerance, then generates deliverables.
problems: Critical phases 1,2,3,7,8; phases 4,5,6,9 are non-critical.
Two orchestrations of the same stages.
rebuild: A second orchestrator beside pipeline.ts. Choose one; the 9-phase form is cleaner for resumability, the generic pipeline is what runs.
nationwide: Texas phases (TxDOT ROW).

name: Bell County dedicated module
purpose: The deepest county: BIS CAD plus ArcGIS GIS, Kofile clerk on bell.tx.publicsearch.us (free 2550x3300 previews), a free plat archive (8,077 plats), FEMA/TxDOT/GIS scrapers, deed and plat analysers and a lot correlator.
behaviours: The clerk portal answers from the server; esearch.bellcad.org does not (geo-block), so Bell CAD data is missing from runs until the Browserbase-for-CAD decision is made.
problems: Owner decision pending on Browserbase for CAD only.
bell-clerk.ts KOFILE_CONFIGS has 72-75 rows; earlier claims about them were wrong.
rebuild: The template for 'curated' counties. Fix the Bell CAD geo-block (host reachable only through another egress) and move county specifics into a profile plus vendor scrapers.
nationwide: Everything Bell: names, Revize plat archive paths, FM-road variants.

name: Milam and Williamson county modules
purpose: Second and third curated counties built by the 'Milam method': sites driven by hand, a profile with golden parcels, dedicated scrapers (Milam GIS; Williamson WCAD and the Tyler Eagle clerk driver).
problems: Williamson parcel FeatureServer, free plat source and deed bridge are still to find (curation plan).
Milam golden parcels exist; no drills are scheduled.
rebuild: Proof that a county takes about a day when the method is followed; formalise it as the onboarding checklist and generate the profile from a probe.
nationwide: Texas county names; the Milam volume/page bridge is a Texas-specific idea.

name: Appraisal district (CAD) layer
purpose: Finds parcel id, owner, legal description, acreage and sometimes coordinates. Vendors: BIS eSearch (about 103 BIS_CONFIGS keys, 104 counties tagged in the FIPS table), TrueAutomation (3 by FIPS table), Harris HCAD, Tarrant TAD, Dallas DCAD, explicit Travis/Williamson/Bexar/Hays/Comal; an AI/Google fallback; and a Comptroller directory of all 254 CADs (241 with websites).
behaviours: FIPS table tags: 104 bis_consultants, 1 hcad, 1 tad, 3 trueautomation, 145 texasfile_fallback.
Williamson's BIS host esearch.wilcotx.gov was NXDOMAIN; Milam's esearch.milamcad.org was dead; both were found only by driving the sites.
problems: 'Configured' is not 'working': few BIS hosts were ever driven.
The BIS DOM pattern was verified on one county (2026-03-07) and applied to 100+.
RECON_INVENTORY lists '15 TrueAutomation counties verified'; the code table has 3.
RECON_INVENTORY lists Williamson as BIS; it is TrueAutomation/Tyler PublicAccess.
rebuild: Use a statewide parcel dataset as the baseline (owner, legal, geometry) and CAD sites as enrichment. Verify each BIS host by driving it, and classify the remaining ~145 counties by vendor from the Comptroller directory.
nationwide: Vendor patterns (BIS, TrueAutomation) are national vendors and reusable; CAD names, the FIPS table and the Comptroller directory are Texas.

name: County clerk records layer
purpose: Searches the county clerk for deeds, plats, easements and liens. Routing is FIPS to vendor, proven vendors only: Kofile 22 counties, Tyler Eagle 9, Avenu 20/20 about 19, eDocTec 2, Aumentum 1, iDocMarket 1 (53 distinct counties); everything else falls to TexasFile.
behaviours: PROVEN_VENDORS = kofile, texasfile, edoctec, tyler (eagle), uslandrecords, aumentum, idocmarket; countyfusion, henschen, idocket and fidlar are configured but not routed.
registrySummary derives from getClerkSystem so it cannot disagree with the router.
The Kofile list was cut from 53 to 22 after probing found 32 dead portals.
problems: Two clerk registries (services/clerk-registry.ts and adapters/clerk-registry.ts) plus KOFILE_CONFIGS in bell-clerk.ts, the Kofile adapter table and the paid-platform registry; adapters/clerk-registry.ts still claims about 80 Kofile and 40 Henschen counties.
Henschen (16) and Fidlar (6) hosts are ENOTFOUND; CountyFusion hosts are live but need logins.
Bastrop is located, not driven to results; Lee and San Saba have no online portal; Hays not found.
TexasFile covers all 254 but is a paywall; no purchase has ever been made.
rebuild: One routing table derived from county profiles; per-vendor adapters behind one ClerkAdapter interface; paid-only, login-required and paper-only as explicit states. Keep the rule 'a vendor is proven by driving it, never by a link'.
nationwide: Vendors (Kofile/GovOS, Tyler, Avenu, Fidlar, CountyFusion, Henschen) operate in many states, so adapters carry over; county URL tables and TexasFile do not.

name: Duplicate county registries
purpose: Nine overlapping tables name counties and vendors; the curation plan counts BIS_CONFIGS 104, KOFILE_CONFIGS 75, the Kofile adapter table 8, services/clerk-registry 22.
problems: Milam had three registries with three wrong CAD answers; one cost a 147 s run.
The paid-platform and Kofile sets had drifted six counties apart.
rebuild: Collapse to county profiles as the only source; generate the rest and fail CI on disagreement (slice 4 of the curation plan).
nationwide: All Texas FIPS.

name: Federal and state free-data clients
purpose: Statewide, county-independent sources: FEMA flood zone, TxDOT ROW, GLO land grants, TCEQ, RRC wells and pipelines, NRCS soils, USGS topo, Comptroller tax, TNRIS LiDAR.
behaviours: FEMA is instantiated in the index.ts flood endpoint and the Bell fema-scraper. TxDOT RPAM is used in row-integration-engine and the Bell txdot-scraper. USGS, Comptroller and TNRIS LiDAR are instantiated in index.ts endpoints.
GLO, TCEQ, RRC and NRCS are imported at index.ts:77-80 and never instantiated (GLO confirmed by a test).
problems: research-modes SOURCE_CATALOGUE marks GLO as providing 'original_survey' although nothing queries it (S-6b).
RECON_INVENTORY: Phase 11 partial, not all clients wired.
TCEQ, RRC and NRCS return the owner nothing today.
rebuild: Define each as a SourceAdapter with a capability and a coverage geometry, call all that apply to a parcel in parallel in Stage 1.5, and show 'queried, nothing found' versus 'not queried' on the dossier.
nationwide: FEMA, USGS, NRCS, NWI are national; TxDOT, GLO, TCEQ, RRC, TNRIS and the Comptroller are Texas; each state needs its DOT, land office, environmental and oil/gas equivalents.

name: Paid document purchase and access
purpose: Free first, then paid: plans purchases by platform (TexasFile $1/page, Kofile, Tyler and others), shows offers with cost, buys on approval, and files the bought image under identity dedupe.
problems: research_document_purchases had 0 rows; no real purchase has run.
The registry marks an iDocket subscription ($50-200/month est.) of unknown billing state.
The CapSolver key was rejected and the solver has no callers.
rebuild: Keep free-first and the deny-on-uncertainty gate; add a per-firm payment method and a clear 'we could not buy because X' state.
nationwide: Single TexasFile account; LandEx (national API) is in the registry.

name: Address normalisation and road-variant engine
purpose: Generates the exact spellings each CAD indexes (Bell: 'FM 436' works, 'W FM 436' returns 0) so a Texas address can be found; plus structured address parts.
problems: The AI variant generator returned truncated JSON in both 2026-09-02 runs (plan phase E); salvage-json-array was added.
rebuild: Keep; make variants a per-vendor rule (BIS index style) rather than ad hoc, and test against golden parcels.
nationwide: Texas road forms (FM, RM, CR, SH, IH); other states need their own (US routes, county roads, PLSS-style addresses).

name: OCR and AI document extraction
purpose: Reads deeds, plats and field notes into structured calls (bearing, distance, curves), monuments, owners and references; multiple readings per call are aggregated.
behaviours: The gather run does no AI; reading is a separate step with an estimate.
READING_SUSPECT_RATIO 1,000 flags suspect readings.
problems: Two AI clients (lib/research/ai-client.ts, worker ai-extraction.ts).
No ground-truth set: the regression harness has one synthetic fixture.
rebuild: One extraction schema (canonical-schema.ts) shared by app and worker; every extracted value keeps its source crop and reading count so confidence is derived, not asserted.
nationwide: Prompts say 'Texas RPLS'; varas and abstracts; Texas State Plane zones named in prompts.

name: Subdivision, adjoiners, ROW, geometric reconciliation and closure
purpose: Builds the lot from plat and deeds, researches adjoiners, integrates TxDOT right-of-way, reconciles calls into a closing boundary and builds the chain of title.
behaviours: Closure tiers: excellent >= 1:10,000, acceptable >= 1:5,000, marginal >= 1:2,500, poor < 1:2,500 hard fail (closure-tolerance.ts:8-14).
Counties may only loosen thresholds within clamps.
problems: RECON_INVENTORY says worse than 1:5,000 hard-fails; the code hard-fails below 1:2,500 (doc and code drift).
Reconciliation needs plat or deed data; non-Bell runs rarely reach it.
rebuild: The strongest differentiator; protect it with real golden parcels (Bell, Hays, Williamson; one metes-and-bounds, one disputed) before any rebuild.
nationwide: TEXAS_MIN_RURAL_RATIO 10,000 and TEXAS_MIN_URBAN_RATIO 25,000 constants; TxDOT ROW; closure standards should be per state and per survey class.

name: Confidence scoring
purpose: Scores every boundary call, lot, side and the whole property 0-100 with a letter grade, flags discrepancies and recommends documents to buy.
behaviours: Worker call score has four factors: sourceMultiplicity (1 source 5 up to 5 sources 25), sourceAgreement (bearing and distance spread thresholds), sourceReliability (txdot_row 25, deed_extraction 22, adjacent_reversed 19, plat_segment 16 down to county_road_default 4) and readingClarity.
Grades: A >= 93, A- 88, B+ 83, B 78 and so on, F < 43.

App-side element confidence weights: source_quality .20, extraction_certainty .25, cross_reference_match .25, geometric_consistency .20, closure_contribution .10; document reliability tiers survey 95, plat 88, deed 85, appraisal 55, aerial 50.
problems: Two independent confidence models (worker and lib/research) with different factors.
Weights and tables are asserted, never calibrated; the regression set is empty.
rebuild: Replace asserted weights with calibration against golden parcels; show the reasons, not just the grade.
nationwide: Document tiers reflect Texas practice; per-state survey-class standards needed.
plans: docs/platform/RECON_INVENTORY.md section 11 (ground-truth set: nothing built beyond one fixture)

name: Reports and exports (SVG, PNG, DXF, PDF, legal description, packet)
purpose: Produces the deliverables: boundary drawing in SVG/PNG/DXF, PDF report, generated legal description, and a field packet.
problems: Two export paths (worker reports and lib/research/export.service).
rebuild: Keep DXF and packet; add Trimble/Carlson/Leica data-collector formats as planned (rw5, fbk, crd).
add: Title-ready exhibit with firm seal block
nationwide: Legal description text follows Texas forms.

name: Run infrastructure (queue, budgets, circuits, health, captcha, browser)
purpose: Guards that keep a run honest and cheap: BullMQ queue, per-run cost ceilings, host circuit breakers and dead-host gates, politeness gaps, a structural site health monitor, a canary framework, browser backend selection and a captcha solver.
behaviours: Dead host: ENOTFOUND or ECONNREFUSED is one strike, two consecutive timeouts are two; revive after 5 minutes.
captcha-signatures and a CapSolver HTTP wrapper exist but no adapter invokes the solver.
problems: The canary table had zero rows; the regression harness has one synthetic fixture.
The browser backend is local Playwright; Browserbase is paid but had zero sessions; 37 chromium.launch call sites were to be routed through browser-factory (inventory).
Playwright, Zod and Stripe versions drift between root and worker.
rebuild: Keep. Wire the canary framework to golden parcels, and make the browser and captcha choice a per-county policy decision.
nationwide: Politeness and legal posture (automation_posture per county) must be per state and per vendor terms.

name: Worker deploy and operations
purpose: A Docker compose worker on a rented box; a systemd timer pulls main, skips while a run is in flight, health-checks and rolls back; shell wrappers per phase; a host DNS sweep script.
problems: Docs disagree on the host (RECON_INVENTORY: Hetzner/droplet; owner-actions: netcup).
worker/relay/server.mjs is the phone receptionist relay, not research.
The PM2 ecosystem file and shell scripts still reference the droplet.
rebuild: Keep the safe auto-update (lock, no deploy over live runs, rollback). Run check-adapter-hosts on a schedule and report into Coverage.
nationwide: Single-tenant worker; multi-firm needs per-firm queues and credentials.
